Its after-state leaves the coral roof on the braked rack, but secondary motion says the discard mouth closes after both roof-bay seats are occupied. Revise the action, after-state and event chain to describe one observable result.","Shot-01 calls the falling roof's path 'terminal discard' after Bot has engaged the mechanism that will catch it. This weakens the visible after-state and continuity into shot-02. Describe it as approaching the discard mouth with the newly engaged catch in its path.","Shot-01 frame 177 does not name the checkpoint tab's exact grip anchor, although the affine rule requires a right-hand grip. Bind it explicitly to an existing named grip; do not introduce the generic selector 'gold tab.'","Shot-03 illustrates checkpoint capture, but the narration says 'before the work starts' after an unsafe overwrite attempt has already begun. Make the restored opening state and the boundary between aborted attempt and actual renovation unmistakable, or the checkpoint reads as late rather than preventive.","Shot-04's hero and purpose are comparative, but its sole focal target is the coral roof. Direction must ensure the preserved teal profile and shared baseline remain co-dominant enough to prove exactly what changed; a coral-only focus can reduce the shot to 'new roof installed.'","Shot-07 weakly expresses 'doesn't just move fast.' It proves the restored version passes, but does not yet stage the contrast between speed and verified safety. Give the recognition hold or Bot's deliberate inspection a clear story function without adding filler motion or exceeding the event cap.","Shot-08 has conflicting mobile dimensions: the declared display bays are 148 authoring pixels wide, or 74 pixels at 360×640 output, while camera continuity calls them 66 pixels wide.
